item.title: Version 1.9.0
item.description:
**Live meeting notes** - Added a meeting window with Notes and Transcript tabs. With notes enabled, drafts refresh about every 30 seconds when the speech engine is available; finishing the meeting generates notes from the complete final transcript. - Choose an OpenAI-compatible endpoint and model in **Settings > Meetings > Notes**. Local servers such as LM Studio and compatible external providers are supported, with model discovery, an optional Keychain API key, and provider compatibility options. - Notes organize summaries, decisions, actions, and open questions, with original source excerpts for review. Copy or export Markdown from the meeting window or History. - Notes are optional and off by default. Meeting audio is transcribed on your Mac; enabling notes sends transcript text to the endpoint you choose. Review generated notes against the transcript before using them as minutes. - Failed notes requests preserve the transcript and last successful draft. Final notes are saved with the meeting when History saving is enabled.
**Focused settings** - Split Text output into Cleanup, Dictionary, and Translation sections, and Meetings into Recording, Notes, and Reminders. - Each category remembers its last section. Search opens the matching section, including advanced notes-provider controls.

item.title: Version 1.8.3
item.description: - Automatic update checks are on by default and can be turned off in Settings > App. Hlas checks at startup and every hour while running, respecting your saved preference. - Failed automatic checks stay silent, including startup configuration failures. Manual checks remain available when automatic checking is off. - Available update alerts now have a menu-bar indicator and a versioned right-click menu item, making background alerts easier to find.

item.title: Version 1.8.2
item.description: - Added **Follow focused display** in Settings > Dictation > Feedback, enabled by default. The on-screen indicator follows the active window's display while visible, carrying its dragged position across displays. If window focus is unavailable, it uses the pointer's display. Turn the setting off to keep the indicator at its saved position. - Recording failure messages now disappear after three seconds instead of ten, followed by the existing short fade.

item.title: Version 1.8.1
item.description:
**A clearer everyday interface** - Redesigned the menu around a prominent Dictate button, a separate meeting action, clearer recording status, and labeled recording and text-output controls. - Added a last-transcript card with completion time, expansion, copy and paste actions. - Made Settings more compact, with grouped navigation, search and clearer descriptions. Processing location now distinguishes This Mac from Own server. - Made the local S1-mini polishing model and its English-only dictation support more visible.
**Guided setup** - Added a five-step setup window with saved progress, an animated explanation of the dictation flow, model preparation, optional automatic paste, and real practice dictation. - Manual copy and paste remains available without Accessibility access. Practice does not paste text, save history, translate, or apply AI cleanup.
**Feedback and recovery** - Refined the recording orb and readable indicator, including the Settings preview. - Clarified clipboard fallback, paste requests, translation failures and history-save outcomes. If translation fails, the original text is kept and English polishing is skipped. - Improved History with an adaptive list/detail layout, Undo Delete and clearer deletion confirmation. - Added a meeting status window with input activity and a visible, cancelable auto-start countdown. - Improved keyboard accessibility and support for reduced motion.

item.title: Version 1.8.0
item.description:
**Meeting speaker labels** - Optionally identify speakers in meeting transcripts with an on-device model. Enable "Identify speakers" in Settings > Meetings and download the model (~200 MB). Speaker identification runs locally after transcription. - Speakers are numbered in order of appearance. When microphone and system-audio activity clearly distinguish your voice, your turns are labeled "Me". - If speaker identification or word alignment fails, Hlas keeps the complete plain transcript. Failed meeting transcriptions can still be retried from the saved audio. - Model downloads, deletion, and transcription are coordinated to prevent overlapping model operations.
**Local Parakeet** - Updated the local speech engine. Existing Parakeet users need a one-time model download (~470 MB) because the model files and cache location have changed.
**Whisper model loading** - Reuse an already downloaded model without checking the old Documents cache, avoiding an unnecessary Documents permission prompt during loading.

item.title: Version 1.7.2
item.description: - New Fast | Polished switch in the menu bar popover toggles AI cleanup (S1-mini) without opening Settings. Fast gives the raw transcript with no post-processing delay.

item.title: Version 1.7.0
item.description: **On-screen indicator** - The floating recording indicator is now a small translucent orb instead of a wide pill — it shows your input level while recording, a spinner while transcribing, and a checkmark when the text lands. - **Drag it anywhere.** Where you leave it is where it comes back, on whichever screen you put it. "Reset indicator position" in Settings › General puts it back at the bottom of the screen. - The transcript itself no longer appears in the indicator — it goes where you're typing, which is where you were already looking. Errors still show their message in full.

item.title: Version 1.6.1
item.description: **Updates** - Hlas now checks for new versions on its own and offers the update when it finds one. Previously it only asked for permission to check on first launch, and did nothing at all if that prompt was declined or dismissed — so updates could be missed indefinitely unless you picked "Check for Updates…" from the menu-bar menu by hand. - This fix only takes effect from this version onward: it is the 1.6.1 binary that knows to check, so 1.6.1 is the last update you may need to reach for the menu item to get.

item.title: Version 1.6.0
item.description:
**Text** - **AI cleanup** (Settings › Text, off by default) — rewrites the transcript on-device with **"S1-mini" by "Superwhisper"**: fillers removed, self-corrections resolved to what you landed on, punctuation and capitalization applied, and spoken numbers, dates, currency and email addresses written out. Four tones, optional bullet lists, optional email layout. English only; downloads a ~350 MB model on first use and runs entirely on your Mac. - Filler-word removal and smart punctuation are disabled while AI cleanup is on — the model does both jobs, and running them together mangles its output. The personal dictionary still applies, before the model sees the text.
**Build** - Xcode 26 and the separately-downloadable Metal toolchain (`xcodebuild -downloadComponent MetalToolchain`) are now required.

item.title: Version 1.5.0
item.description:
**Dictation** - Optional floating on-screen indicator while recording/transcribing, with error feedback (Settings › General › Feedback; off by default) - Press Esc to cancel a recording; Cancel button in the popover - Optional sound cues (off by default); Launch at Login - "Paste again" and tap-to-expand for the last transcript; Copy/Paste Last Transcription and Recording Mode in the menu-bar right-click menu - Too-quiet takes now say so instead of silently doing nothing; errors are shown on the menu-bar icon
**Settings & History** - Settings reorganised into General, Transcription, Translation, Text, Meetings, Advanced; window keeps its size and position - Whisper models show downloaded state and size, can be deleted or re-downloaded - History: select, delete (Delete key / context menu), group by day, filter dictation vs meeting, Clear History; "Save transcripts to History" toggle and retention period - Personal dictionary is an editable table - Onboarding lets you choose Parakeet or Whisper and shows download progress
**Fixes & privacy** - Microphone recovers after sleep/wake (wake listener never fired before) - Translation can no longer hang the app - Dictionary replacements containing `$` or `\` no longer corrupt text; filler-word removal no longer deletes "like"/"actually" - Dictation audio is deleted from disk after transcription; transcripts no longer written to the debug log or notifications - Clipboard is restored faithfully (images, rich text), transcripts are hidden from clipboard managers, and paste/Enter only fire in the app you dictated from - Meeting audio is kept until transcription succeeds, with a Retry button - Remote server: no default address, unencrypted-connection warning, more reliable transfer and clearer errors
